name: dsh-plugin-resolver
purpose: Install the right DSH plugin in one call: search the catalog, disambiguate same-name entries, pick a version the running DSH accepts, install from registry or GitHub source, and verify the mount.

tools.name: plugin_search
tools.output: catalog candidates with owner, stars, npm name, install command, ambiguity flag

tools.name: plugin_resolve
tools.output: package, install spec, registry, source-build requirement, notes

tools.name: plugin_install
tools.output: applied state, bundle and loader entry, restart decision, next step

versionRule.peer: every same-namespace @deepseek-ai/dsh / @deepseek-ai/dsh-* peer accepts the running version; sibling libraries on other version lines are excluded from runtime constraints
versionRule.selection: first compatible version; explicit version skips resolution

ambiguity: keep every candidate visible; the caller supplies owner= or a full spec
restart: compare bundle set and runtime file hashes; the plugin manager result is authoritative
